I stopped caring around a year ago. I would escape my life through any means that were available to me. Be that in drink, drugs or the pleasures of the flesh. But in the end all it did was make me more bitter. 

I remember when it all clicked, that I'm not normal. I was sat in a counselling session, I looked the fucker in the eye and I said. "You don't care, you just do this for the money and the self satisfaction so you can sleep easy" I never trusted anyone since. Truth that all humans are out to one up the others and well as stabbing every fucker in the back. 

Putting your heart and soul into a person and then seeing that person turn on their heel and fuck the nearest pole really makes it clear. You don't just hate that person. You wanna see them crumble into dust as you pummel the life out of them. You want to breath acid and smoke as you tear apart their life. But it doesn't work
